import matplotlib.pyplot as plt; plt.xkcd(); fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(10,4))
# stowed
ax1.set_xlim(0,1.1); ax1.set_ylim(0,0.6); ax1.set_aspect('equal'); ax1.set_title('stowed in 1.0x0.5x0.5 box')
import matplotlib.patches as p
ax1.add_patch(p.Rectangle((0,0),1.0,0.5,fill=False,lw=2))
ax1.text(0.5,0.52,'1.0 m start box, h 0.5 m')
for x in [0.15,0.85]:
    c=plt.Circle((x,0.15),0.15,fill=False,lw=2); ax1.add_patch(c); ax1.text(x,0.15,'300mm')
ax1.add_patch(p.Rectangle((0.05,0.28),0.90,0.06,fill=False,lw=2)); ax1.text(0.45,0.31,'frame 0.95m')
ax1.add_patch(p.Rectangle((0.35,0.34),0.30,0.08,fill=False,lw=2)); ax1.text(0.37,0.37,'hopper lowered')
ax1.plot([0.1,0.6],[0.42,0.45],lw=2); ax1.text(0.1,0.46,'mast folded 0.45m')
ax1.text(0.02,0.02,'w 0.5m ok')
# deployed
ax2.set_xlim(0,1.2); ax2.set_ylim(0,1.3); ax2.set_aspect('equal'); ax2.set_title('deployed high-lift 1.05m lip')
for x in [0.3,1.0]:
    c=plt.Circle((x,0.15),0.15,fill=False,lw=2); ax2.add_patch(c)
ax2.text(0.3,0.02,'front axle'); ax2.text(0.95,0.02,'rear axle')
ax2.plot([1.0,1.0],[0.3,1.05],lw=3); ax2.text(1.02,0.65,'guide 0.60m')
ax2.plot([0.85,0.85],[0.3,0.45],lw=3); ax2.text(0.6,0.35,'actuator 0.15m 4:1 chain')
ax2.add_patch(p.Rectangle((0.95,0.9),0.35,0.15,fill=False,lw=2)); ax2.text(0.97,0.97,'hopper 15kg')
ax2.text(1.02,1.1,'pour lip 1.05m pivot 0.45-1.05m')
ax2.annotate('',xy=(1.0,0.0),xytext=(0.3,0.0),arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->')); ax2.text(0.55,0.05,'wheelbase 0.70m')
ax2.annotate('',xy=(1.30,0.9),xytext=(1.0,0.9),arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->')); ax2.text(1.05,0.85,'overhang 0.30m')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('sketch.png',dpi=150)
